interpretation: Useful primary base and uniform advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; pooled and donor advantage is excluded under both. All primary intervals include zero. Residual donor and pooled comparisons remain unresolved. Raw sums exclude useful advantage over all rivals; raw-sum base favors personal adaptation at zero only under writer resampling without establishing the useful margin, and raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods.
